Parameter covariance is not supplied.

## Observation datasets

### kbr\_b2\_dewaele\_2012\_table1\_compression

- **Description:** Complete 121-row 298 K KBR B2 compression table from five runs.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Dewaele; Belonoshko; Garbarino; Occelli; Bouvier; Hanfland; Mezouar
    - **Year:** 2012
    - **Source:** Phys. Rev. B
    - **Volume:** 85
    - **Locator:** 214105
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.85.214105
- **Source location:** Table I, page 214105-2
- **Associated EOS records:** kbr\_b2\_dewaele\_2012\_vinet\_1
- **Notes:** The paper reports pressure uncertainty below 2% through 162 GPa and relative volume uncertainty below 0.001 under 50 GPa and below 0.005 above 50 GPa; row-wise values are not printed. The KCl value at 3.45 GPa is transcribed as 47.783 angstrom^3 rather than the text extractor's dropped leading 4.
